title: Mobile app check (Android / iOS)
description: Opens your app through Appium and explores its screens, reporting crashes, dead ends and slow or broken screens.
needs: Appium running on this computer and an emulator or phone connected
Either the app's package name (already installed) or the app file (.apk / .ipa)
notes: Needs an Appium server and a device or emulator. The dashboard cannot start those for you.

requireOneOf.message: give the app's package name (already installed) or the path to the app file — one of the two is needed

target.label: App package name (already installed)
target.help: Android: the app's id, like com.mycompany.shop. iOS: the bundle id. Give this OR the app file below.

target.label: App file to install (.apk / .ipa)
target.help: Full path of the file on THIS computer. Installs a fresh copy for the run.

target.label: Starting screen (Android activity)
target.help: Only if the app does not open on its own.

target.label: Device / emulator name
target.help: Leave empty to use the first connected device.

target.label: Appium server address
target.help: Where Appium is listening. The default is right for a normal local setup.

target.label: Keep the app's data between runs
target.help: Off = a clean app each run. On = stay logged in from earlier runs.

details.label: How deep to go from the first screen
Never tap buttons whose text contains
details.help: Comma-separated. Added to the built-in safety list (delete, log out, pay, buy, reset, submit …), which always stays.
